site_ui.lead: Turn lawfully obtained data into counsel-ready investigative leads without mistaking anomalies for proven misconduct.
site_ui.summary: False Claims Act, SEC, and IRS matters have different standing, original-information, procedure, and award requirements, with uncertain outcomes and potentially multiyear collection timelines. Keep eligible whistleblower awards separate from lawful research retainers and counsel-directed analytics services, underwriting service work on its own margin rather than treating contingent awards as recurring revenue.

flow: Use public records and lawfully accessible information without unauthorized access or data exfiltration.
Identify reproducible patterns and test innocent explanations, data errors, and materiality.
Preserve provenance and distinguish direct evidence, analytical inference, and unresolved questions.
Have qualified counsel assess eligibility, public-disclosure issues, privilege, deadlines, and reporting duties.
Follow the chosen program's submission requirements and any applicable court-seal restrictions.
Support authorized follow-up and record outcomes without booking speculative awards as earned revenue.
